checks.text: On initial load, the page shows the heading "Snake Game", the text "Score: 0", the text "Best: 0", and the button "Start".
Clicking the button "Start" changes the button label to "Restart", the text "Score: 0" remains, and the board displays a snake of length 1 at the center cell.
After clicking "Start", pressing the key "ArrowUp" moves the snake one cell up; the snake occupies the cell directly above its starting position and the cell below is empty.
After clicking "Start", pressing the key "ArrowLeft" when the snake is moving up does not change the snake's direction; the snake continues moving up.
After clicking "Start", pressing the key "ArrowUp" then "ArrowRight" moves the snake up one cell then right one cell; the snake occupies the cell diagonally up-right from the start.
After clicking "Start", when the snake eats a food item, the text "Score: 0" changes to "Score: 1" and the snake length increases by 1.
After clicking "Start", when the snake collides with the board boundary, the text "Game Over" appears and the button label changes to "Restart".
After a game over with a score of 3, clicking "Restart" resets the text "Score: 0", removes the text "Game Over", and the button label changes to "Start".
Reload keeps the best score: after achieving a score of 5 and reloading the page, the text "Best: 5" is displayed.
